message: 図書館の謎
After school, I head over to the library.
KiraFes was a huge success. I'm genuinely happy about that.
However, I can't really explain specifically what we did or how it led to such a great outcome. All I can say is that it's thanks to everyone...

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, should I check the politics shelves? Or maybe the how-to section for a book on the art of living?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't bother.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're planning to study and analyze what the Student Council pulled off at KiraFes, aren't you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That kinda stuff is nothing more than cheap tricks, ya know? Besides, calculating every single word and move ten steps ahead basically means throwing away who you are.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy...」

name: Paqy
message: 「KiraFes went well because Lord Synn was Lord Synn, right? Who the hell's gonna follow a Lord Synn who stops being himself?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, that's right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Helena, what are you doing in the library?! ...Wait, you're looking something up, aren't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan... I told Ria the exact same thing Paa-chan just said last year.」

name: Synn
message: 「Last year, you mean... to Ria-senpai when she was Student Council President...?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's all I'll say on the matter. Think the rest through for yourself, Synn-chan.」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee. Though it looks like you've already figured it out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, thank you very much.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, right, let me correct just one misunderstanding.」

name: Helena
message: 「I didn't come here to read--I came here to steal a book.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why would you do that? You're the Chairwoman of the Board, aren't you, Miss Helena? Isn't the entire collection here under the Kujou family's management?」

name: Helena
message: 「Not entirely. After all, Melilot is the librarian.」

name: Helena
message: 「Honestly, that girl even goes around building secret studies without permission♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I have heard all sorts of rumors about Miss Melilot, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, you look like you're having fun, Miss Helena.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, of course! Sneaking into the underground archives to pinch a book, then escaping while dodging the traps Melilot set up!」

name: Helena
message: 「That was entertaining for the first time in a while. Here you go」
Helena-san handed me a single book.
It's a strange tome...
I'm not well-versed in printing or bookbinding techniques, yet even I can tell how bizarre this book is.
Every single page is made of antique-looking parchment, yet there's no fading or staining from age at all.
Whoa!? Even though it's properly bound, it's not printed--it's a handwritten manuscript!
W-What era was this written in? Even when I flip through the pages, no dust or mold kicks up.
On the contrary, a modern scent like ballpoint pens and highlighters wafts off it.

name: Helena
message: 「What do you think of that book?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry for opening it without asking. Here, I'll give it back」

name: Helena
message: 「You took a quick peek at it, didn't you? What was written inside?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. The phrasing of the text is a little archaic」

name: Synn
message: 「But it's not as difficult as a classical literature textbook--it's just the normal writing style used back in the Meiji or Taisho eras, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「At this rate, if I take my time, I can definitely read it」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll never be able to read it for all eternity. I can't break the lock on that book」

name: Synn
message: 「A lock...? Anyone can just open it and read it normally, can't they?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, Paa-chan...」
I don't really get it, but Helena-san has started responding when I call out to her!!

name: Helena
message: 「Did you know? Melilot is a towering figure when seated」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's that supposed to mean?」

name: Helena
message: 「When Melilot sits down, she ends up taller than me♪」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Helena-san, saying something so blatant...」

name: Helena
message: 「All right! No reaction」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot has abnormally sharp hearing, so if she were in the library, she'd come flying right over after hearing that!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then! Let's sneak the book back while she's away. Bye-bye, Synn-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, I'm heading outside too. I don't have any business left here」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Master Synn, you see that book Helena just brought? That's a grimoire someone penned recently」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a weak reaction!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, bookstores are lined with tons of fantasy-related books, aren't they」

name: Paqy
message: 「Haaah, Master Synn really is a true big shot」
